ranking.title: Native method source or availability differs
ranking.technical_explanation: Function availability, source text, or native-looking function metadata differs from the Real baseline.
ranking.action_reason: Investigate the evidence and validate against an independent Real browser capture.

ranking.title: Module exposes a surface absent from the Real baseline
ranking.technical_explanation: The enabled capture contains a field that was absent from both the Real artifact and the Plain comparator capture; this is most consistent with synthetic object-shape expansion.
ranking.action_reason: Collect an independent native probe before changing the module.

ranking.title: Baseline surface remains missing
ranking.technical_explanation: A property present in the Real artifact is absent after enabling the module.
ranking.action_reason: Collect an independent native probe before changing the module.

ranking.title: Native descriptor differs
ranking.technical_explanation: Property attributes or accessor shape do not match the Real baseline.
ranking.action_reason: Collect an independent native probe before changing the module.

ranking.title: Prototype identity or chain differs
ranking.technical_explanation: The enabled object is backed by a different constructor/prototype identity or exposes a different chain.
ranking.action_reason: Collect an independent native probe before changing the module.

ranking.title: Plugin and MimeType identity is inconsistent
ranking.technical_explanation: The relationship between Plugin, MimeType, and enabledPlugin is not represented identically.
ranking.action_reason: Collect an independent native probe before changing the module.

ranking.title: Aggregate fingerprint hash differs
ranking.technical_explanation: The hash is a consequence of underlying properties and must not be patched directly.
ranking.action_reason: Treat the aggregate hash as an audit signal; fix its component properties instead.
